observations_used: 红黑硬边几何序列/逐帧硬切 → 开场卡片与红黑压屏
合掌→星芒→眼睛 → 把情绪收在一只眼睛/星芒上

used: R03 女神异闻录5皇家版-开场
observations_that_changed_the_cut: R03 seg-0000167: pure red field, black hard-edged wedges, stepped hard cuts → the film's red/black stage and its 2-frame diagonal shard covers on every section cut.
R03 style card: halftone dots + radial speed lines → the dot screen on every graphic field and the radial lines behind the teeth close-up and the result card.
R03 seg-0012200: star-burst flash on the beat → the teal landing ring, the lens sparkle and the white flash at 25.10.
R03 'stepped zoom via cuts' (逐级硬切拉远) → the title slams at 1.22× and settles in 3 steps rather than easing smoothly.
rejected: Purple / magenta / neon-green palette and the P5 characters and masks (they would fight Anon and Kino).
The game's soundtrack and any P5 audio.
Smooth cinematic cameras and long dissolves — the reference's language is hard cuts.

scope: One film per condition. Both directors used official DeepSeek Flash at max; timing includes technical recovery and project-rate costs vary by time band. The selected film is an owner preference for this trial.
